title: Agro-climatic zones of Andhra Pradesh
quote: Six zones, named after rivers (Godavari, Krishna), direction (North Coastal, Southern) and physical conditions (Scarce Rainfall, High Altitude)

boxes.title: Six zones → districts
head: Zone
Districts (13 old)
rows: Hill/tribal areas of Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam, East Godavari

boxes.title: Rainfall & drought
items: **Kharif 2026**: all **28** districts in deficit; worst: Annamayya, Prakasam, Chittoor, Markapuram, Visakhapatnam
**PMDS** (pre-monsoon dry sowing) under natural farming uses residual soil moisture

boxes.title: Agro-ecological regions & ANGRAU
items: Agro-ecological zone = agro-climatic zone + **landform** (modifies climate, **length of growing period**)
AP in **Southern cotton zone** (with Telangana, Karnataka)
ANGRAU focus: drought-resistant paddy, flood-tolerant pulses, pest-resistant cotton, **drone** precision farming

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Zones still on **13 old districts**; not re-cut after **April 2022** reorganisation (now **28 districts**)
⚠ Not the **six public employment zones** under **Art. 371-D**
